subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S55 across all 3 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S55 is a focused performance engine, appearing in only three M models: M2 Competition, M3 and M4 — all from the same 2014–2020 generation era.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with hybrid-system ancillaries additionally accounted for on MHEV/PHEV applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The S55 has a documented crank hub concern on some models — a press-fit friction design that can slip under load, throwing off engine timing. This is a genuine M-specific characteristic we account for during inspection.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed S55 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
